correctness.rationale: Directly reconstructed conditional moments of z=x-s C x_{k-D}; the explicit positive quadratic V=(1+ps)x²-2psxy+p vartheta s²(1+ps)y² has exact conditional drift s[vartheta(s+p s²)-2]x². For p>0, determinant p s²[vartheta(1+ps)²-p]>0; summable E[x_k²] gives sufficiency, while nondecreasing positive E[V] rules out convergence at and above equality. At p=0 the unused lag coordinate drops out; independent symbolic polynomial check agrees. Two-point curvature (.5,1.5), p=.5, s=1.2 gives lhs 2.4, versus 1.5 without lag and 1.92 without variability. Verification is a consistency check, not the proof.
